comment: User-editable compartment registry. Each compartment: id (file suffix + override key), label (UI), scope (recallBoundary hard predicate), loadWhen (the neutral pointer text — the ONLY hint the public surface ever carries), strong (phrases that route silently), ambiguous (single words that pre-fire 'did you mean...?'), prefixes (explicit tags that route silently and win over everything), stockCategories (named LexCore stock session categories that also route here — an allowlist, never a whole layer).

compartments.label: Intimate
compartments.loadWhen: an adult session the user explicitly initiates

compartments.label: Medical
compartments.loadWhen: the user asks about their own health, meds, or wellbeing

compartments.label: Finances
compartments.loadWhen: the user asks about their money, accounts, or bills

compartments.label: Venting
compartments.loadWhen: the user explicitly asks to revisit a vent — never surfaces otherwise
